question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank No.3.**
solution:
The correct answer is 'endeavour'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• plan - a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.
 
• labour - work, especially physical work.
 
• order - the arrangement or disposition of people or things in relation to each other according to a particular sequence, pattern, or method.
 
• endeavour - earnest, prolonged, and industrious effort.
 
 
 
• From the line with the blank, we can infer that the **blank 3 **needs a word that would describe the effort of planting trees which is rewarding. 
 
• Hence, endeavour is the most appropriate option for blank 3. 
 
• So, option 4 is the correct answer.

Correct paragraph__ - *Tree plantation is the (1)__process__ of transplanting saplings or seeds to maximise the amount of greenery and focus on promoting (2)__afforestation__. Planting trees can be a very rewarding and fruitful (3)__endeavour__! Not only is it (4)__ecologically__ beneficial for this planet, but it also contributes to helping create an environmentally friendly place to live, as trees help reduce pollutant (5)__concentration__.*
